profile     @net-anon
            As net, but the sandbox gets a synthetic address in BOTH families instead of the host's.
defined in  builtin:base.toml

  includes         @net
  address          10.13.13.2/24 via 10.13.13.1
                   synthetic; the host's own address is not copied inside, so
                   the sandbox does not learn your LAN or ISP-attributable
                   address
  address6         fd00:5e79:1::2/64 via fd00:5e79:1::1
                   synthetic; the host's own address is not copied inside, so
                   the sandbox does not learn your LAN or ISP-attributable
                   address

To see what this actually produces for a directory:
  snug --dry-run -p @net-anon <dir>
